'''Frederica Darema''' is a [[Greek people|Greek]]-[[Americans|American]] [[physicist]]. She proposed the [[SPMD]] programming model in 1984 and [[Dynamic Data Driven Application System]]s (DDDAS) in 2000. She was elected [[IEEE Fellow]] in 2004.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://services27.ieee.org/fellowsdirectory/home.html|title=IEEE Fellows directory|publisher=IEEE|access-date=2021-07-24}}</ref>

==Biography==
Darema received her BS degree from the school of physics and mathematics of the [[University of Athens]] - Greece,<ref name="afbio">{{cite web |url=https://www.af.mil/About-Us/Biographies/Display/Article/108635/dr-frederica-darema/ |title=Biographies : DR. FREDERICA DAREMA |first= |last= |work=af.mil |date=December 2010 |accessdate=9 June 2020|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170512031251/https://www.af.mil/About-Us/Biographies/Display/Article/108635/dr-frederica-darema/|archive-date=2017-05-12}}</ref> and MS and Ph. D. degrees in theoretical nuclear physics from the [[Illinois Institute of Technology]] and the [[University of California, Davis]], respectively, where she attended as a [[Fulbright Scholar]] and a distinguished scholar.<ref name="afbio" /> After physics research associate positions at the [[University of Pittsburgh]] and [[Brookhaven National Laboratory]], she received an APS Industrial Fellowship and became a technical staff member in the nuclear sciences department at [[Schlumberger Doll Research]]. Subsequently, in 1982, she joined the [[International Business Machines|IBM]] [[Thomas J. Watson Research Center]] as a research staff member in the computer sciences department and later on she established and became the manager of a research group at IBM Research on parallel applications. Darema has been at the [[National Science Foundation]] since 1994, where she has managed the New Generation Software and Dynamic Data Driven Application Systems programs. During 1996-1998 she completed a two-year assignment at [[DARPA]]. She is now at the [[Air Force Office of Scientific Research]].<ref name="afbio" />
